title: Oz's Notes
subtitle: Obscure observations, curious takes on complexity of being.

posts.title: The Dictionary Is Running Late
posts.description: Eleven forty on a weeknight, and someone is asking a machine for a sonnet about their cat. They do not want the sonnet. AI tools keep producing experiences faster than we can name them, so here is a small glossary to start with.

posts.title: The Pusher Moved Into Software
posts.description: A capsule machine, a trial that wants your card, a stranger at the school gate with a free sample. Two of them are real. The third was a myth for a century, until software gave the free first hit the conditions it always needed.

posts.title: The Two Stripes at Molineux
posts.description: In 1959 an East German army club painted over the third stripe on its Adidas boots rather than admit the socialist state made worse footwear. Sixty-seven years later, UEFA pays its top-ranked club thirty-six times what it pays its bottom one, by statute. A look at what concentrates the game.
